dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL-NOS), de novo, germinal-center B-cell (GCB) subtype

stage_i.quote: Ann Arbor stage IA, non-bulky, with no B symptoms. FDG PET-CT shows a single nodal region (contiguous right cervical levels II-III), with the largest node 3.1 cm.

stage_nonbulky_no_b.quote: Ann Arbor stage IA, non-bulky, with no B symptoms. FDG PET-CT shows a single nodal region (contiguous right cervical levels II-III), with the largest node 3.1 cm.

stage_pet_no_marrow_biopsy.quote: Bone marrow biopsy and lumbar puncture are not indicated because PET shows no marrow or CNS involvement.

mn_overstaged.quote: Ann Arbor stage IA, non-bulky, with no B symptoms.

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: BCL2 is positive in about 30% and MYC in about 15% of tumor cells, so this is not a double-expressor lymphoma; Ki-67 is about 55% and EBER ISH is negative. FISH shows no MYC, BCL2, or BCL6 rearrangement, excluding double-hit/triple-hit disease.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH shows no MYC, BCL2, or BCL6 rearrangement, excluding double-hit/triple-hit disease.

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: BCL2 is positive in about 30% and MYC in about 15% of tumor cells, so this is not a double-expressor lymphoma

prog_ipi_low.quote: IPI 0 (age <60, stage I, ECOG 0, normal LDH, no extranodal sites), age-adjusted IPI 0, and CNS-IPI 0.

prog_cns_ipi_low.quote: CNS-IPI is 0 (age <60, stage I, ECOG 0, normal LDH, no extranodal sites, no renal/adrenal involvement), corresponding to a very low risk of CNS relapse (well under 1%).

tx_curative_rchop.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles without consolidative radiation.

tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles without consolidative radiation.

tx_no_rt_goals.quote: The key reason for choosing chemotherapy alone is that she has favorable limited-stage (IA, non-bulky) GCB DLBCL and strongly wishes to avoid neck radiation because of her sister's radiation-related hypothyroidism

tx_alternatives.quote: 4 cycles of R-CHOP followed by 30-36 Gy involved-site radiation would be the alternative

mn_six_cycles.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles without consolidative radiation.

mn_pola_preferred.quote: I would not use Pola-R-CHP or other novel regimens, which are not established for stage I disease.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use Pola-R-CHP or other novel regimens, which are not established for stage I disease.

mn_observation_or_rt_alone.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles without consolidative radiation.

cns_low_no_prophylaxis.quote: Low. CNS-IPI is 0 (age <60, stage I, ECOG 0, normal LDH, no extranodal sites, no renal/adrenal involvement), corresponding to a very low risk of CNS relapse (well under 1%). I will not give intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate CNS prophylaxis, and I will not perform a routine lumbar puncture or brain MRI

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate CNS prophylaxis

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: I will restage with FDG PET-CT from skull base to mid-thigh 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 and interpret it with the Lugano/Deauville 5-point scale.

resp_interim_pet.quote: Interim PET after 2 cycles is not recommended outside a clinical trial.

work_pregnancy_test.quote: Before starting R-CHOP I will add: a serum beta-hCG to exclude pregnancy, since she is premenopausal and on an oral contraceptive

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: hepatitis B (HBsAg, anti-HBc, anti-HBs), and hepatitis C serologies; and baseline echocardiogram (LVEF 63%).

work_echo_reviewed.quote: She is a candidate for full-dose curative R-CHOP.

sup_stop_coc_switch.quote: She should stop the combined oral contraceptive and use a progestin-only or non-hormonal method; I will not use routine anticoagulation, but I will maintain mobility and have a low threshold to evaluate VTE.

sup_coc_reason.quote: I will also stop her combined oral contraceptive during chemotherapy because migraine with aura plus estrogen increases ischemic stroke risk.

sup_fertility_counselling.quote: urgent reproductive-endocrinology referral with AMH/antral follicle count and oocyte or embryo cryopreservation (a 2-4 week delay is acceptable for stage IA non-bulky disease), plus discussion of a GnRH agonist during chemotherapy

fit_goals.quote: Very fit: a 45-year-old woman with ECOG 0, weight 64 kg, BSA 1.72 m2, normal CBC/CMP, normal LDH, LVEF 63%, no cardiac or pulmonary disease, never smoker, and working full time. She is a candidate for full-dose curative R-CHOP.
